security_audit.summary: The skill intentionally sends document content to jstodocx.com, so the network findings are confirmed as low-severity operational risks. The API key findings are placeholders or a normal user-provided environment variable, and the Ruby backtick findings are Markdown formatting or fixed curl examples. No prompt injection or malicious semantic intent was found.

remediation.issue: External API submission of document content
remediation.suggestion: Add a clear privacy notice that document content is sent to jstodocx.com and require confirmation for confidential content.
Keep using environment variables for API keys and add explicit guidance to avoid terminal logs and shared shell history.

remediation.issue: Shell examples may trigger conservative scanners
remediation.suggestion: Mark curl commands as optional examples and describe direct HTTP request alternatives for agents with built-in request tools.

content.user_title: Generate Word DOCX Files with jstodocx API
content.value_statement: Teams often need Word files without adding DOCX libraries to every project. This skill uses the jstodocx.com API to create DOCX files from HTML, source text, or templates.
actual_capabilities: Converts basic HTML headings, paragraphs, lists, and tables into DOCX files through the API.
Creates DOCX files from report, invoice, proposal, resume, and meeting-notes templates.
Archives JavaScript source text into a readable Word document with optional line numbers.
Documents authentication headers, rate limits, response headers, and common error codes.
Shows response validation checks for DOCX content type, filename, and ZIP magic bytes.
limitations: Requires network access to jstodocx.com and may require an API key.
Supports basic HTML formatting, not pixel-perfect browser rendering.
Sends document content to an external API, so sensitive content needs user approval.
Does not execute JavaScript or generate DOCX files locally.

use_cases.title: Create release documents from HTML
use_cases.description: Convert basic release notes, plans, or summaries into a downloadable Word file.

use_cases.title: Archive source code for review
use_cases.description: Place JavaScript source text into a readable DOCX document without running the code.

use_cases.title: Generate business templates
use_cases.description: Create invoices, proposals, reports, resumes, or meeting notes from controlled fields.

prompt_templates.title: Create a DOCX from HTML
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple document export.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use jstodocx-api to create a Word file from this basic HTML. Ask before sending confidential content to the API. Save as release-plan.docx.

prompt_templates.title: Archive JavaScript Source
prompt_templates.scenario: Convert source text into a reviewable Word document.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use jstodocx-api js-source mode to archive this JavaScript source as a Word document. Include line numbers and do not execute the code.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Template Document
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a business document from structured fields.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use jstodocx-api template mode to create an invoice DOCX. Use the provided fields and verify the returned file before reporting completion.

prompt_templates.title: Design an API Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced integration planning for an agent workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a DOCX generation workflow with jstodocx-api. Cover authentication, rate limits, validation checks, retry behavior, and privacy approval before sending content.

output_examples.input: Basic HTML release notes with headings, a bullet list, and a small table.
output_examples.output: A DOCX file named release-notes.docx with matching headings, paragraphs, list items, and a simple table.

output_examples.input: JavaScript source text for an export helper, requested as a review archive.
output_examples.output: A Word document containing the source text as readable content with optional line numbers.

output_examples.input: Invoice fields with a heading, paragraph, bullet items, rows, and footer text.
output_examples.output: A formatted invoice DOCX built from the supported invoice template fields.

best_practices: Confirm before sending confidential or regulated content to the external API.
Use environment variables for API keys and avoid printing credentials in logs.
Verify the response content type and DOCX signature before presenting the file.
anti_patterns: Do not use js-source mode to run or validate JavaScript behavior.
Do not assume complex HTML, CSS, scripts, or iframes will render in Word.
Do not retry rate-limited requests in a tight loop.

faq.question: Does this skill create DOCX files locally?
faq.answer: No. It sends supported content to the jstodocx.com API and saves the returned DOCX file.

faq.question: Can it convert any HTML page perfectly?
faq.answer: No. It supports basic document HTML such as headings, paragraphs, lists, inline formatting, and simple tables.

faq.question: Does js-source mode run JavaScript?
faq.answer: No. It treats JavaScript as plain source text and formats it into a Word document.

faq.question: When is an API key needed?
faq.answer: The endpoint may be public or may require a key, depending on site configuration.

faq.question: How should API keys be handled?
faq.answer: Use environment variables or user-provided secrets, and never print, save, commit, or summarize the key.

faq.question: Is it suitable for confidential documents?
faq.answer: Only after explicit user approval, because document content is sent to an external service.
